name: STA_IsEnabled
summary: Stub (no Steam layer in this exe): meant to give whether the Steam/community layer is enabled; always answers int 0.
semantics: Handled inside the X2 dispatcher (STA natives are X2 group numbers 41, FL 40). The case reads no argument and answers int 0 at once (ResumeTaskWithIntVm); nothing else happens. The Steam/achievement/stat/DLC/DID back end of the X3 Steam builds is not present in X3AP.exe or X3FL.exe, so scripts must treat every STA_ answer as "not available".
